start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:read-a-saved-record-and-show-its-value-the-same with store {"where": "postgresql database example_shop on my own computer", "language": "SQL (PostgreSQL)", "credential_name": "example-shop-postgres-connection"} and records ["decision:d1"]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the values are read from the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps them, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:read-a-saved-record-and-show-its-value-the-same" with store and the records to show, in order.
3. The first run proves the reads on the example values in the same store; every attempt must give its outcome, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run reads the records the same way and shows each value with its facts, or its refusal reason. Nothing is written.

worked_examples.title: Show the latest value of one decision
